summary: Software Engineer (Machine Learning) at Google, driving cross-backend model portability and on-device deployment for the Keras ecosystem. Authored official Keras.io guides, shipped LiteRT export for PyTorch backend, and contributed 75+ PRs across Keras, KerasHub, and TensorFlow — infrastructure used by millions of developers. Previously built production on-device AI at Samsung R&D (computer vision, face recognition, sensor fusion) and Qualcomm (DSP-optimized edge AI). Passionate about open-source ML infrastructure, reinforcement learning, and algorithmic trading.
